name: What is the approximate cost to install a hardwired bedroom night light?

mainEntity.name: What is the approximate cost to install a hardwired bedroom night light?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for hardwired bedroom night light installation typically ranges from $150 to $400 per fixture, excluding the cost of the light itself. This estimate covers labor for electrical work, such as running new wiring, installing junction boxes, and connecting the fixture to an existing power source. Factors like the accessibility of wiring, the need for new switches, and the type of fixture (e.g., recessed vs. surface-mounted) can influence the final price. We provide detailed quotes after an assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation costs for hardwired night lights typically range from $150-$400 per fixture, excluding the light itself, depending on wiring complexity.
